en: So you're the one who drove Team Aqua out of the museum! The whole city's talking about it.
I'm Scott. I travel all over looking for trainers with real promise. And you might just be one!
Here, let me register you in my PokéNav. I'd like to keep an eye on how you do.
Keep at it, and I'm sure we'll meet again. Take care!
Welcome! I'm the Energy Guru! I sell whatever your Pokémon needs to grow strong!
Come back whenever your Pokémon need a boost!
